Syncs:

the NTSC decomp at 879d6f4a;
rac1-decomp with PRs 76, 77 and 79 folded in (the PRs themselves aren't merged there);
the PAL/NTSC function map refreshed after both.

pullRequests.title: Port playtest fixes: cutscenes, effects, wrench, flight, launcher
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: fix/port-playtest
pullRequests.body:
Fixes from a playtest of the rac1 PAL port, plus a simpler launcher flow.
Gameplay

In-game cutscenes start (3eb352a6). The routine that starts a level's in-engine scene (func_L00_00299B68) was stubbed out as a renderer, so no scene trigger ever fired. That covered Veldin's opening scene and Clank at the crash site. It's now C, and the port uses the matched request routine again, so proximity triggers fire with no button.
Wrench throw:

The wrench leaves Ratchet's hand when thrown…

commits.headline: fix(renderer): draw the PAL game in its 60 Hz mode's 448-line layout
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The port keeps the PAL game in its own 60 Hz mode (14e72695), which
resets the picture to 448 lines: the draw buffer then starts at block
0xE00, not the 512-line layout's 0x1000. The renderer knew only 0x1000,
so the game's copy of the draw buffer into the display was drawn from an
empty texture over the world, and its copy of the draw buffer onto
itself laid stripes of stale texels: the menus showed only the GUI over
black, smeared.

The draw buffer's block now follows the display the game…

commits.author: Lynder063

Tauri CLI's file reader passes the raw file contents directly into base64::STANDARD.decode()
which rejects trailing newlines (ASCII 10). Writing the trimmed key without a newline
resolves 'Invalid symbol 10, offset 348'.

commits.headline: feat(port): Start skips the flight between planets
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
With "Skip cutscenes" on, Start now also ends the flight between
planets. The transition (space.c) loops on the flight until D_0015F6FC
is set, then waits for the next level's load; the loader itself waits
for the flight to clear its playing flag (D_0015EF4A, ReRAC's 0x15ee4a)
before it unloads the old banks. The skip does what the flight's end
does: clears the flag and sets the word.

It acts only while the flight plays, which the flight's update
(func_00230A90, now wrapped) marks each frame:…

commits.author: Veradictus

bilinear filtering (TexturePool::add's new `linear`), the others keep
their mipmaps.

The metal pass now takes each moby's own shine distance (+0x73: 0x18
for a class with metal packets, 32 for the logo), passed in…

commits.headline: fix(port): draw a glow packet's part-transparent texels
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The Gadgetron hologram's lettering showed as broken outlines: it is a
glow packet (drawn unlit in the moby's glow colour, blended) whose
texture is mostly part-transparent texels (alpha 0x22..0x5E around the
opaque strokes), and the glow pass left a cutout's texels below full
alpha out, as the solid pass does, while the cutout pass skips glow
faces. The glow pass now blends every texel at its alpha.

Checked on Novalis (levels re-extracted with the metal packets): the
GADGETRON band reads whole…

commits.headline: feat(launcher): export, re-import and manage models and textures on the Mods page
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A "Models and textures" panel under the level editor's steps: export a
level's characters and objects, textures, scenery or everything (the
folder opens when it is ready), import an edited export back as an
overrides pack, and the packs themselves: on or off, order, remove, add
a .zip or a folder, or drop one on the window. Play with your mods now

commits.author: Veradictus

when the class is made, so `-> list[tuple]` read the method and the
module failed to import (CI, and the Python 3.12 the installers carry;
3.14 defers annotations). Annotations are now postponed.
